manifest.description: Diagnose concurrency-shaped waste: blocking/synchronous IO inside a request, event-loop, or async hot path, and independent awaitable operations awaited serially where they could run concurrently.
when_to_use: synchronous file/network/DB IO sits inside an async fn or event-loop handler
a hot path awaits independent futures one after another instead of joining them
a runtime is blocked by a long CPU or IO call that should be offloaded
a profile or operator hint shows wall-clock latency dominated by serial waits
anti_patterns: do not flag sequential awaits that are genuinely data-dependent (each needs the prior result)
do not flag blocking IO in startup/CLI/one-shot code that is not a hot path
do not propose concurrency that introduces ordering, rate-limit, or resource-exhaustion hazards without saying so
do not use for fearmongering about async without a concrete blocked-runtime or serial-wait site
